record.question: Delegation of financial powers is necessary because:
options: Delegation of financial powers transfers the ultimate financial responsibility of Government from the Finance Department to the spending departments
Delegation of financial powers allows departments to incur expenditure without budget provision, subject to post-facto approval

Delegation of financial powers enables decisions on expenditure and financial matters to be taken at appropriate levels, thereby ensuring administrative efficiency and avoiding unnecessary reference to higher authorities
Delegation of financial powers reduces the burden of the Accountant General
